metaTitle: Custom Reflective Pants & Shorts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom reflective pants and shorts with your logo. Ideal for safety teams and night events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Reflective pants and shorts add visibility to your branded apparel, making them essential for safety teams, night shifts, and evening events. The reflective strips or prints catch light, keeping your crew seen in low-light conditions. Choose from cargo styles or athletic fits, and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery. These are practical giveaways that double as safety gear for construction crews, road workers, or event staff.
heroAltText: Custom reflective pants and shorts with high-visibility stripes and embroidered logo for safety teams
